python_eval_rce.description: Use of eval() results in remote code execution.
python_eval_rce.remediation: Use ast.literal_eval() or avoid dynamic execution.

python_exec_rce.description: exec() can lead to arbitrary code execution.
python_exec_rce.remediation: Avoid exec(), use subprocess with safe args.

js_eval_rce.description: JavaScript eval() allows execution of untrusted code.
js_eval_rce.remediation: Use JSON.parse or other safe alternatives.

js_dom_xss.description: innerHTML assignment may cause DOM XSS.

php_eval_rce.description: PHP eval() allows remote code execution.
php_eval_rce.remediation: Avoid eval(); use safe templating engines.
